outcome: Authoring contract bound to canonical capabilities with separated diagnostics
owner_impact: The formal authoring contract no longer carries an independent semantic capability model. It references the 11 implemented canonical capability UUIDs/keys through static existing-interface bindings, while canonical meaning/status/version/provenance remain registry-owned. Validation now distinguishes semantic capability gaps from authoring-language, runtime/configuration, forbidden/security-boundary and ordinary type/validation failures. All six extension-request classes remain available for Professor triage with no automatic rejection.

next.text: #348 is the known successor for production cutover and legacy capability-state retirement. #348 has not started in this owner turn.

technical_evidence: Authoring contract vlab.authoring/0.7 exposes canonical_capability_bindings for all 11 frozen implemented capabilities and no longer exposes capability_model.
Bindings contain canonical UUID/key and existing authoring/runtime surfaces only; they do not duplicate canonical definitions, implementation state/version, or publication provenance.
Static consistency tests require every frozen implemented canonical registry row to have exactly one matching authoring binding and prohibit unbound/duplicate capability identity.
Compiler/runtime code remains static and does not query Supabase/canonical registry at runtime.
Diagnostics preserve low-level compiler category and add diagnostic_class plus request_class only when the failure maps to a durable extension class.

Unsupported authoring-language features are no longer remapped to semantic simulator-capability gaps; forbidden boundaries map to security_boundary and runtime contract failures map to runtime_configuration.
Existing Configuration/Initialization/Controller/Metrics syntax, observations/actions/runtime semantics, simulator/kernel/physics behavior and Experiment artifact interface are unchanged.
MCP server/interface are 3.5.0/13; capability-request interface remains vlab.capability-request/4.
